# testing_undiscriminated_union_array (Resource)

UndiscriminatedUnionArray Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_undiscriminated_union_array" "my_undiscriminatedunionarray" {
  acronym_id = {
    # ...
  }
  items = [
    {
      a = {
        value_a = "...my_value_a..."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `items` (Attributes List) Array of plain union items for 'create' operation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Optional

- `acronym_id` (Attributes) Test case for Go acronym (ID) capitalization in union variant names that include a numeric suffix. Two anonymous object variants cause a collision-disambiguation numeric suffix on the second variant (e.g., AcronymId2), which the Go SDK correctly capitalises to AcronymID2. Verifies that generated provider code references the properly capitalised field name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acronym_id))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Optional:

- `a` (Attributes) Test case - model name matches in both 'create' and 'update' (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--a))
- `b` (Attributes) Test case - only exists in 'create' union, missing from 'update' (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--b))
- `undiscriminated_union_array_item_c` (Attributes) Test case - only exists in 'update' union, different model name from 'create' variants (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--undiscriminated_union_array_item_c))
